tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa'i 'khri shing drwa ba dral mdzad de// yon tan rgya mtsho zhi lam mchog sgrogs pa// rkang gnyis dbang po nye bar brnyes pa yi// go 'phang dam pa thob par mdzad pa rgyal// blo gros dpag yas tshig gi gter mnga' ba// 'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// chos rje dpal ldan chos kyi rgya mtsho yi// rnam thar me tog gus pas brgyu bar bya// khyod ni sbyangs pa'i shes bya la// rnam par mkhas pa lta ci smos// yang dag tshig 'bru don bcas gzhan// 'thad bcas mkhyen pa ngo mtshar che// gang zhig phun tshogs mi zad mnga'// de la'ang 'jig rten spyod mi 'jug /de gcig kho nar ma zad de// spos bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi tshig don 'di la rgyu// tha dad yod ces gang gsungs pa// de la mkhas pa bye bas kyang*// chos dang mthun par brgal mi nus// mnal tshe chos rnams glegs bam gyi// tshul gyi khong du chud gyur pa// de yi mod la chos kun gyi// de nyid gzigs pa khyod la 'dud// ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan brjod la// yang srid rnam pa bdun dag tu// legs par sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir// rang byung nyid du mngon rtogs gyur// de la rtog ge bdag 'dra yi// blo yang the tshom mi 'jug ste// gtan tshigs bzang po dang ldan pa// de bas khyod la bstod phyag 'tshal// gang phyir rtog ge la sbyangs shing*// sgra la rnam par mkhas pas kyang*// khyod kyi gsung la skyon 'di zhes// chos bzhin brgal du ma mchis pa// de nyid phyir na khyod kyi thugs// rnam par dag par kho bos 'tshal// mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam kun tu// bsngags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gting dpag dka' ba'i chos la yang*// khyod kyis 'di las mi 'da' zhes// nges par gsung pa de las gzhan// mdo sde rnams las de bzhin 'byung*// de 'dra kho na legs gsungs pas// khyod gsung thub pa kho na 'dra// bskal pa'i don yang legs gzigs pas// dpang gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// yi ges 'dul la yi ge dang*// rtsis pa rnams la rtsis dang ni// 'tsho byed rnams la 'tsho byed gzhung*// chos 'dod rnams la chos kyang ston// gang gi phan dgongs thugs rje yis// nye bar phan la de ston pa// ston mchog khyod 'dra ma mthong ste// kun mkhyen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra// lha dang grub par rig 'dzin gtso// lto 'phye'i dbang pos nyer bsten cing*// rgyal ba yis kyang mthun par bsngags// de slad khyod kyi rnam thar la// dad pas 'jug pa smos ci 'tshal// khums pa de dag dge dpyad na// kun nas don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// sdom brtson khyod ni thos pa dang*// don yod mthong na nyams su 'phel// bsten na dge legs rin chen gter// stsol mdzad gcig pur gyur pa lags// yon tan med la sgro btags nas// skye bo ngan rnams yon tan sgrogs// yon tan can khyod mkhas rnams kyis// yon tan bsgrags pa khyod la 'dud// mang du thos pas blo gsal ba// grags ldan sdom brtson dbang rnams kyi// blo gros mthong bas khyod la slar// dad pa'i me tog rgyas par 'gyur// ji bzhin gzigs pas thugs dag pa// blo mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro rnams thugs rjes mi gtong ba// brtse chen khyod la skyabs su mchi// ji ltar 'bad kyang khyod kyi drin// lon par 'gyur snyam mi bgyid de// gang gis khyod drin 'di 'dra zhes// rnam thar bsams na mchi ma dku// brgal bar 'os min nongs mi mnga'// dri ma med la 'thad pa can// rnam par dag la mtshan bzang ba// khyod la gang gis lan lon 'gyur// 'brel pa'i sgo nas mi bstod de// bka' drin sgo nas cis ma bstod// gal te phyogs su lhung nyid na// bstod par gyur na smad pa'i gnas// du bas me bzhin rnam thar las// nang gi yon tan legs brtags te// grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa// 'di 'dra kho nas bstod lags grang*// dad pa'i sgo nas rtabs tshul gyis// tshig gi sdeb sbyor btang snyoms gyur// tshig la dgyes pa'i mkhas rnams dang*// tshig gi mnga' bdag bzod par gsol// bdag nyid chen po blo gros rgya mtsho yi// yon tan me tog gus pas spel ba las// bsod nams grub pa gang yin de yis bdag

/srid gsum bla ma'i go 'phang thob par shog /de ltar bstod 'di dpal ldan kun dga' yi// rgyal mtshan gyis spel 'di la gang dgyes pa// blo gsal de la bla ma'i thugs rje yi// ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur// 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la spyi bos reg pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la mnga' brnyes shing*/ gdung rgyud rnam par dag pa'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa brda sprod pa/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
